```{r fun_defs_illu}
process_cdb_raw <- function(dat, cdb_args_raw) {
  cdb_class <- command_block_classes[command_block_classes$keyword == cdb_args_raw$X1[1], ][["command_block"]]
  class(cdb_args_raw) <- c(cdb_class, class(cdb_args_raw))
  cdb_args <- cdb_args_raw %>% parse_command_args()
  m0 <- Mapping$new()
  m0$dat_mod <- dat
  
  arg_list <- list(
    cdb = structure(
      list(),
      class = cdb_class
    ),
    mapping = m0
  ) %>% append(
    cdb_args
  )
  do.call(apply_command, arg_list)  
  
  list(
    cdb_class = cdb_class,
    cdb_args = cdb_args,
    result = m0$dat_mod
  )
  
}

tab_labels_wide <- function(df) {
  varl_table <- df |>
    datenanpassr:::tab_varlabs(remove_empty = FALSE) |> 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = varlab) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(val = "varlab", .before = 1)
  vall_table <- df |>
    datenanpassr:::tab_vallabs(remove_empty = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::rename(val = nv) |> 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = vallab) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(val = as.character(val))
  dplyr::bind_rows(varl_table, vall_table)
}

join_labs <- function(df) {
  labs <- tab_labels_wide(df)
  if (nrow(labs) == 0) {
    labs <- labs |> dplyr::bind_rows(dplyr::tibble(val = NA_character_))
  }
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        .fns = as.character
      ),
      val = NA_character_,
      .before = 1,
      type = "values"
    ) |> 
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      labs |> dplyr::mutate(type = "labels")
    )
}


print_cmd_exe <- function(dat, cdb_args_raw) {
  res <- process_cdb_raw(dat, cdb_args_raw)
  input_data <- dat %>% excelish()
  
  old_table <- join_labs(dat)
  new_table <- join_labs(res$result)
  
  join_cols <- dplyr::union(names(old_table), names(new_table))
  
  old_gt <- old_table |>
    gt::gt(
      groupname_col = "type"
    ) |> 
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") |> 
    gt::cols_label(val = "") |> 
    color_gt_labels()
  new_gt <- new_table |>
    gt::gt(
      groupname_col = "type"
    ) |> 
    color_gt_labels()
  
  tibble::lst(
    old_gt,
    new_gt
  )

}
color_gt_labels <- function(gt_obj) {
  gt_obj |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = list(
        gt::cell_fill(color = "#D4E6B4")
      ),
      locations = gt::cells_body(
        rows = val == "varlab")
    ) |> 
    gt::tab_style(
      style = list(
        gt::cell_fill(color = "#D7E9E9")
      ),
      locations = gt::cells_body(rows = type == "labels" & val != "varlab")
    ) |> 
    gt::tab_style(
      style = list(
        gt::cell_text(color = "#999999")
      ),
      locations = gt::cells_body(rows = type == "labels")
    ) |> 
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") |> 
    gt::cols_label(val = "")
}

illustrate_cmd_block <- function(dat, cdb_args_raw) {
  cmd_block <- cdb_args_raw %>% purrr::set_names(LETTERS[seq_len(ncol(.))]) %>% excelish()
  gts <- print_cmd_exe(dat, cdb_args_raw)
  htmltools::div(
    class = "flex-container", 
    htmltools::div(style = "align-self: flex-start", gts$old_gt),
    htmltools::div(style = "font-size: 45px", "&"),
    htmltools::div(style = "flex-item", cmd_block),
    htmltools::div(style = "font-size: 45px", "=>"),
    htmltools::div(style = "align-self: flex-start", gts$new_gt),
  )
}
```
